summary: Serve Home Manager browser assets from the original package

rules.detail: Static asset canonical-path containment remains enforced.

compatibility.detail: Home Manager uses the original package web root rather than the PTY wrapper's per-file symlinks, avoiding rejected static assets when a PTY package is configured.

downtime.detail: No additional downtime beyond normal Home Manager daemon service activation.

manual.detail: No configuration changes are required; normal Home Manager activation applies the corrected web root.

recovery.detail: Normal Home Manager generation rollback remains available.
